_about: Denisse's model choices, in one place (AGENTS.md Rule 0). Each entry: why, the env var that overrides it (still wins when set), and the value used otherwise. model_config.py reads this; DENISSE_CONFIG points at another copy (tests, a private tweak).

chat.why: The Ollama model the brain talks to. Must be pulled locally; num_ctx 8192 must fit the 8 GB GPU (AGENTS.md). Change it only after scripts/model_bakeoff.py and eval/run_eval.py.

whisper.why: faster-whisper size for speech-to-text. small.en is ~480 MB, downloaded once; it shares the GPU with the chat model (stt_whisper.py docstring).
